Documenting a workflow means screenshots, cropping, arrows, and typing out every step. StepGrab does it for you: hit record, do the task once, and every click comes back as an annotated screenshot with the step already written. Native Mac menu bar app, on-device, no account, nothing uploaded. Export as GIF, PDF, MP4, clickable HTML, Markdown, or vertical video — one recording, your brand color. Free tier is real. Pro $2.99/mo, $12.99/yr, or $44.99 once. [...] For years my answer was the same ritual: take screenshots, crop them, draw arrows in Preview, paste it all into a document, send it off. Then three weeks later someone asks the same question, the app has updated, and half my screenshots are wrong.

StepGrab came out of six months of fixing that for myself. It lives in the Mac menu bar. You hit record, do the task once, and stop. Every click comes back as an annotated screenshot with an arrow on what you clicked and a step description written by a model running on your Mac. Export it as a GIF, a PDF or an MP4. StepGrab is a native macOS app that turns one recorded task into an annotated screenshot guide, entirely on your device, with no account and no upload. Guidde is a cloud platform built around AI-narrated video, aimed at teams that need shared workspaces, translation, and helpdesk integrations.

### Can StepGrab make videos like Guidde does?

StepGrab can export a guide as an animated GIF or MP4 on its Pro tier, but its core output is a cropped, annotated screenshot with a numbered arrow and a written step description. Guidde's core output is an AI-narrated video with voiceover, generated in the cloud.

# The automatic step-by-step guide creator.

Turn any process into a professional Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) or tutorial. StepGrab captures your screen at every click, adds numbered arrows, and generates the guide automatically — 100% locally on your Mac.

macOS 14.0+ · Free to try · No credit card required

## Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

### Auto Capture

Just start recording and click through your workflow. Every click becomes exactly one step — frozen at exactly the right moment.

### Looks hand-crafted

Every step is a true-to-Mac screenshot: the floating window with rounded corners and shadow — no desktop background, no menu bar, no clutter. [...] Yes. StepGrab is a native macOS alternative to browser-based documentation tools like Scribe or Tango: it captures every app on your Mac — not just the browser — runs 100% offline with no account required, and exports PDF, GIF, and MP4 without a per-seat team subscription. See the full comparison →

Still have questions? Visit the Help page →

## Show, don't tell.

Free for your first 5 guides. No account required, and signing in raises the limits.

macOS 14.0+ · Free to try · No credit card required [...] ### The floating HUD keeps you in flow.

While you record, a lightweight panel shows your status, step count, and live thumbnails of every capture. Drop a step you don't need, undo the last one, continue, or export — without ever leaving your workflow.

StepGrab floating HUD with live screenshot previews

### Your guides, your look.

Pick the arrow color, line width, and length that match your brand. Show the cursor at the click point, hide desktop icons — every export follows your design rules.

StepGrab design settings: arrow color, line width, arrow length

### Set up once. It just works.

Light or dark exports, Dock icon on or off, launch at login, HUD position and previews — StepGrab adapts to the way you work, then stays out of your way.
